title: ModuleBOutputContract
description: Production-facing Module B Prognostic Output Schema for SIH 2026 Problem Statement SIH26170. Zero-Anchored Residual HistGBM with regime-conditioned conformal prediction intervals and QA advisory decision support.

component_id.description: Unique identifier of the device under screening (e.g. COMP_042).

lot_id.description: Manufacturing or screening cohort identifier (e.g. LOT01, LOT14).

parameter_name.description: Electrical test parameter according to MIL-PRF-19500/703 Table I.

predicted_value.description: Point forecast at 168h horizon reconstructed from 24h baseline plus predicted delta. Returns NaN/null when data are insufficient.

lower_90.description: Lower bound of the 90% regime-conditioned conformal prediction interval in physical units.

upper_90.description: Upper bound of the 90% regime-conditioned conformal prediction interval in physical units.

lower_95.description: Lower bound of the 95% regime-conditioned conformal prediction interval in physical units.

upper_95.description: Upper bound of the 95% regime-conditioned conformal prediction interval in physical units.

regime.description: Forecasting regime selected based on whether 24h excess drift is within training-derived threshold tau_p.

uncertainty_width_90.description: Span of the 90% prediction interval (upper_90 - lower_90) in physical units.

uncertainty_width_95.description: Span of the 95% prediction interval (upper_95 - lower_95) in physical units.

crosses_60.description: For RDS(on): True if 90% prediction interval straddles the 60.0 mOhm screening margin (lower_90 <= 60.0 <= upper_90). False otherwise.

entirely_below_60.description: For RDS(on): True if upper_90 < 60.0 mOhm. False otherwise.

entirely_above_60.description: For RDS(on): True if lower_90 > 60.0 mOhm. False otherwise.

crosses_65.description: For RDS(on): True if 90% prediction interval straddles the 65.0 mOhm specification ceiling (lower_90 <= 65.0 <= upper_90). False otherwise.

entirely_below_65.description: For RDS(on): True if upper_90 < 65.0 mOhm. False otherwise.

entirely_above_65.description: For RDS(on): True if lower_90 > 65.0 mOhm. False otherwise.

advisory_status.description: Advisory recommendation for QA engineering review. Informational decision support only; NO autonomous machine control or scrap authority.

early_drift_signal.description: Observed drift of component between 0h and 24h in representation space (u24 - u0).

excess_drift.description: Component drift relative to peer lot median drift (component_drift - lot_drift).

threshold_proximity.description: Physical margins to critical screening thresholds and specification ceilings.

reason_for_advisory_status.description: Explicit physical and mathematical rationale for advisory status without generic AI buzzwords.

unit.description: Physical measurement unit (uA, V, mOhm, nA).

is_valid.description: True if input measurements were sufficient and prognostic evaluation succeeded.

refusal_reason.description: Explicit explanation if evaluation was refused due to insufficient data.

predicted_drift_rate.description: Predicted drift rate over 144h horizon (predicted_value - value_24h) / 144.0 [unit/hour].

safety_slope.description: Calculated safety slope toward configured safety threshold (safety_threshold - value_24h) / 144.0 [unit/hour].
